item.description: Yesterday Dropbox announced that they will close their Mailbox app and service in February.1 This is yet another case of a big company acquiring an email-client startup and shutting it down, and it doesn’t surprise me. Nobody wants email clients (except for me and my girlfriend), because GMail’s web interface is good enough or even great for most people. Writing an email client is deceptively hard, and yields relatively small payoff.
